_note: HELD-OUT SET. Write these questions without reading agent_tools/model_router.py or the development set (router_questions.json), and do not change the rules or the prompt after seeing results here. Each slot names a category only; replace every REPLACE value. The evaluators refuse to run while any question starts with REPLACE.

_how_to_label.route: aggregation (a Jira count should run), knowledge (a wiki page should answer it), or no_query (nothing should run: no project named, two projects in one question, or a project outside BILL, PAY, INFRA).
_how_to_label.spec: Only for aggregation. Keep the fields the question states and delete the rest. Projects: BILL, PAY, INFRA. issue_type: Incident, Bug, Task, Change. priority: P1 to P4. status: Open, In Progress, Resolved, Closed. group_by: priority, status, issue_type. Delete spec entirely to score routing only.
_how_to_label.dates: today is 2026-10-12. created_from is the first day included; created_before is the day AFTER the last day included. Calendar quarters and months. 'This quarter/month/year' runs through today, so created_before is 2026-10-13. 'Last N days' ends today: created_from is today minus N-1 days. No period stated: last 90 days, created_from 2026-07-15, created_before 2026-10-13.
_how_to_label.conventions: A P1 to P4 with no type named is an Incident. Outages are incidents. Status only when a state is named or implied by a verb.
